$comment: Maps upstream source files to category ids and default severities. Edit this file to re-tune the bundled lexicon, then run `npm run lexicon:build`. `severity` drives the default policy: only `high` produces a `block` decision. `defaultEnabled: false` keeps a broad, false-positive heavy list out of the default `categories: ['all']` selection; it can still be requested explicitly or via `categories: ['*']`.

Vocabulary/GFW补充词库.txt.description: Contains many ordinary words (联系, 网络); enable explicitly when you need maximum recall.

Vocabulary/其他词库.txt.description: Loosely related terms (place names, job titles).

Vocabulary/广告类型.txt.description: Ordinary commercial words (兼职, 招聘).

Vocabulary/暴恐词库.txt.description: Violence, terrorism and extremist organisations. Blocked by the default policy.

Vocabulary/民生词库.txt.description: Everyday words about social topics (打人, 拆迁).

Vocabulary/涉枪涉爆.txt.description: Firearms and explosives trade. Blocked by the default policy.

Vocabulary/网易前端过滤敏感词库.txt.displayName: 网易前端过滤敏感词库
Vocabulary/网易前端过滤敏感词库.txt.description: Contains ordinary English words (this, name); enable explicitly when you need maximum recall.

Vocabulary/零时-Tencent.txt.description: Very large general list with ordinary words (IS, of); enable explicitly when you need maximum recall.
